scope: Direct synchronous ContextEngine.get_context in one small immutable TypeScript development fixture. This is not a Codex A/B, MCP startup, actual model token usage, billing or task-success benchmark.
implementation: Request-local verified snapshots bounded to 8 MiB of cached UTF-8 content, discarded before final secure validation; this is not a total Python-heap/RSS bound.

Internal indexed metadata avoids materializing snippets or marking candidates Current; public search/get_symbol continue secure source reads. Selected source and source-backed memories are securely read and checked again before storage.
A complete source superset can transactionally replace fully contained earlier spans only if the full response fits; partial overlaps are excluded and failed replacements preserve existing evidence.

validation.ruff: Passed for owned source/tests/harness; root performs the complete repository checks.

limitations: Five repeats per final case; p95 is the observed maximum and is not a stable tail-latency estimate.
Counterbalanced arm/case order, fresh cloned databases and matched prompts; OS/provider caches were not reset, and later requests reuse an arm session/process.
process_time measures the local Python process, excluding Git child CPU. The secure-read counts come from a separate profiled request and count function invocations, not actual filesystem I/O.

The final selector intentionally changes two case responses; all pairs remain comparable, and all individual observations are retained. Component data cannot establish coding quality on unseen repositories or token/cost savings.
Initial snapshot-only timing was mixed; the overlapping test/browser measurements are retained and labeled as confounded.
